test_diff_opt_correctness: test diff-optim correctness across SGD, Adam, AdamW optimizers with various model configurations
test_gradient_correctness: test gradient correctness by comparing autograd gradients against finite difference approximations
test_frozen_parameters: test that diffopt handles models with frozen parameters that have requires_grad set to False
test_get_apply_round_trip: test get_trainable_opt_params and apply_trainable_opt_params round-trip to verify learned hyperparameter extraction and restoration
test_diff_opt_callback: test gradient callback functionality by applying different gradient scaling callbacks and verifying parameter divergence
